subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Which orphan-repair strategy should own https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76888: this narrow stale-internal-drop branch, the broader preserve-as-context branch in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759, or a third narrowed contract?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same session-state bug but intentionally choose different prompt semantics, and green helper tests do not settle that maintainer-owned contract choice.

options.title: Prefer proven preserve-as-context candidate
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the likely canonical path if maintainers accept preserving the older turn as context-only and its stronger runtime proof.

options.title: Continue this narrow drop branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only after redacted embedded-agent logs or terminal output prove stale internal handoffs are dropped and `sessions_send` remains preserved.

options.title: Request a third contract
options.body: Pause both candidates and specify a narrower session-state rule if neither existing semantic choice matches maintainer intent.

recommendation.title: Prefer proven preserve-as-context candidate
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the likely canonical path if maintainers accept preserving the older turn as context-only and its stronger runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in PR 65478 is the behavior being narrowed or replaced.
